headline: EPAM Systems (EPAM) Is Up 12.5% After Joining OpenAI Partner Network With Major AI Certification Push
summary: On 28 July 2026, EPAM Systems announced it had joined the OpenAI Partner Network as an Advanced Partner to help large enterprises deploy safer, scalable AI solutions by integrating OpenAI models into core operations under strict security and compliance frameworks. An important aspect of this move is EPAM’s plan to certify more than 5,000 consultants with over 10,000 OpenAI-related credentials in the first year, underscoring a large-scale workforce shift toward AI-centric delivery.
